source_title: eTeamSponsor Launches Game Day Ticketing - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
CONCORD, Calif. , Oct. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- eTeamSponsor, the all-in-one institutional funding platform for K-12 and higher education, today announced the launch of eTeamSponsor Ticketing, a mobile-friendly digital ticketing solution built for game day.
For more than 15 years, schools and universities have relied on eTeamSponsor for easy, effective fundraising. Ticketing brings that same trusted experience to the gate. Fans buy tickets in seconds from any phone, staff scan them at entry, and athletic departments see every sale in real time.
Because Ticketing is built into the eTeamSponsor platform, every ticket buyer connects to the same supporter data that powers a school's fundraising, giving days, and sponsorships.
"Schools have trusted us with their fundraising and financial transactions for more than 15 years," said Sean Connors, CEO of eTeamSponsor. "Athletic directors want one partner for every way their community supports them. With Ticketing, every fan who walks through the gate becomes part of the same system that powers their fundraising. One Platform. Every Supporter. More Opportunity. It's one more way we help generate a dollar for your campus."
Mobile-friendly purchasing from any device
Full connection to fundraising, giving days, and sponsorships
eTeamSponsor Ticketing is available now. To learn more or schedule a demo, visit www.eteamsponsor.com .
Founded in 2010, eTeamSponsor is the all-in-one funding platform trusted by K-12 schools, colleges, and athletic programs nationwide. With $300M+ raised, it helps schools generate the most money in the least time through fundraising, giving days, and digital ticketing.
